ground: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RTS continuous ground material atlas for AsteraCraft. Generate one 1536x1152 opaque image, exact 4 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, absolutely no gutters, borders, labels or perspective. Orthographic flat top-down surface texture fills each entire square. ROW 1: muted neutral warm brown earth. ROW 2: muted terracotta dusty soil, not vivid orange. ROW 3: cool neutral grey lunar soil. Each row is a closely matched uniform COLOR AND LUMINANCE FAMILY: col1 quiet compact fine soil, col2 same soil with very sparse tiny embedded grains, col3 same soil with subtle desaturated short moss at ground level, col4 same soil with faint eroded ancient paving barely visible. All four columns in a row MUST have identical average hue and brightness and restrained contrast, so neighboring surfaces naturally match. Ground should be 90% calm and uncluttered, fine photographic hand-painted pre-rendered classic RTS material quality. Absolutely NO rocks larger than sand grains, NO grass tufts, NO debris, NO raised objects, NO centered feature, NO mottled patches, NO checkerboard, NO dark seams, NO radial or directional lighting gradients, NO tile bevels, NO diamond outlines. Detail will come from separate props in the game. All edges must have equal color and texture density with interiors for seamless mirrored world-space sampling. Real material not flat color, not blurred.
decor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent terrain decoration sprite atlas for original RTS AsteraCraft. Exact 4 columns x 3 rows equal cells on transparent canvas 1536x1152. Each independent sprite fully isolated, generous transparent padding, no overlap, no text or lines. Pre-rendered classic late-1990s isometric RTS art, ground plane slopes 2:1, camera high 3/4 overhead, consistent lighting upper left, crisp small-game-scale silhouette. ROW1 warm brown world: col1 small clump of dry tawny grass, col2 low grey-brown rock cluster, col3 short ruined weathered stone wall segment oriented northeast-southwest, col4 tiny weathered stone arch remnant with broken top. ROW2 muted terracotta world: col1 small alien fern with muted olive leaves, col2 small rust shale cluster, col3 short ruined low red sandstone wall segment oriented northwest-southeast, col4 dry branching root stump. ROW3 grey lunar world: col1 small pale dusty lichen and wiry grass clump, col2 small charcoal grey basalt stones, col3 low dark grey ruined technical barrier slab oriented northeast-southwest, col4 small broken ancient grey metal pillar. Each object sits directly on transparent background with only small soft contact shadow. NO ground tile, NO floor plate, NO base plinth, NO surrounding grass carpet, NO buildings, NO unit characters, NO glow. These are unobtrusive sparse map background decorations, detailed but subdued. Actual alpha transparency outside objects.
extra_decor: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent decoration sprite atlas for original AsteraCraft RTS. Exact grid EIGHT columns x THREE rows on 2048x768 transparent canvas. 24 individually isolated small props, generous transparent margins within each equal 256x256 cell. No text, labels, lines, no base tiles. Classic polished pre-rendered isometric late 1990s RTS art, overhead three quarter camera ground ratio2:1, light upper left, muted natural palettes. Row1 warm brown temperate world, in order: sparse low dry grass tuft; low tangled olive scrub bush; three tiny scattered pebbles; fallen dark dead branch; broken short stone fence angled NW-SE; broken stone pillar stump; small crumbled stone rubble heap; pair of low dried reed clumps. Row2 muted rusty red alien world: small succulent cluster; broad dusty olive alien shrub; tiny rust colored pebbles; curled dead reddish root; low crumbling red brick fence angled NE-SW; eroded red sandstone obelisk stump; small grey rusted mechanical wreckage pile; small pale dusty mushroom cluster. Row3 cool grey lunar world: sparse grey wire grass; dark wiry thorn bush; tiny angular slate flakes; weathered fallen grey pipe; broken low grey metal fence angled NW-SE; small old grey antenna stump; small broken grey mechanical panel debris; pale lichened stones. These objects are clearly different shapes, clean silhouettes, readable when rendered only30 to90 pixels wide. NO tall buildings, no characters, no glow, no ground plates or surrounding soil, no overfilled cells. Genuine alpha transparency outside each object with very subtle small contact shadow.
